question_text: A road maintenance team of 6 DPWH workers can repair a barangay road in 12 days. If 3 additional workers with the same work rate join the team, how many days will it take to finish the repair?

hint_ladder.title: Think about the relationship
hint_ladder.text: When you add more workers to a job, does the time go up or down? That's the key to solving this.

hint_ladder.title: The magic constant
hint_ladder.text: In work problems, the total work stays the same. Multiply the original workers by the original days to find that constant.

hint_ladder.title: Find your new numbers
hint_ladder.text: You now have 6 plus 3 workers. That's 9 people. And you already know the total work from the first hint.

hint_ladder.title: One simple division
hint_ladder.text: Take the total work (72) and divide it by the new number of workers (9). That's your answer.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you divided 72 by 12 (original workers) instead of by 9 (new workers).

B.text: Correct. With 6 workers needing 12 days, total work is 72 man-days; 9 workers finish in 72÷9 = 8 days.

C.text: You might have chosen C because you subtracted 3 days from 12, thinking adding 3 workers reduces 3 days.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you set up a direct proportion (6/12 = 9/x) instead of inverse, yielding 18.

next_time_rule: Workers × Days = constant. Multiply to find total work, then divide by new workers. Never use direct proportion.
blueprint_id: Ratio and Proportion — inverse proportion manpower problems
deconstruct_text:
Ate tip: Isipin mo—may 6 DPWH workers sa barangay ninyo, inaayos nila ang kalsada ng 12 araw. Parang bayanihan, kapag dinagdagan mo pa ng 3, mas mabilis matatapos.

Una, hanapin ang total work: i-multiply ang 6 workers × 12 days = 72 man-days. Yan ang constant—hindi nagbabago kahit ilan pa ang tumulong.

Ngayon 9 na sila (6 + 3). I-divide ang 72 sa 9, equals 8 days. Yan na! Mental Trick: ‘Workers × Days’ parang ‘Tao × Oras’ sa fiesta—more tao, mas mabilis maubos ang trabaho.

Iwas sa common trap: Wag mag direct proportion tulad ng 6/12 = 9/x, magiging 18. Laging inverse—mas marami manggagawa, mas kaunti ang araw.
